Container.Name: gameerr
Container.Overview: Gameerr is a request and discovery manager for video games. Users pick their platforms, browse releases, trending games and all-time charts per genre, and request games that an admin approves. Approved requests go to Questarr or QuestarrNG (PC, Linux, Mac) or to ROMarrNG (all other platforms). Game data comes from IGDB.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: TZ database name of your time zone

Config.Name: IGDB client id
Config.Description: Client id of your Twitch application, required for game data

Config.Name: IGDB client secret
Config.Description: Client secret of your Twitch application

Config.Name: Questarr URL
Config.Description: Optional, for example http://questarr:5000. Takes PC, Linux and Mac requests.

Config.Name: Questarr API key
Config.Description: Optional, SeerrNG provider key of QuestarrNG

Config.Name: ROMarrNG URL
Config.Description: Optional, for example http://romarr:6868. Takes every other platform.

Config.Name: ROMarrNG API key
Config.Description: Optional, SeerrNG provider key of ROMarrNG
